LOADINGTIPS.tip: Most enemies can harm you just by touching you. Consider all their touches the inappropriate kind your mom warned you about. Better to only let them touch your sword. ...Wait, that sounded dirty...
It's often safer to take out flying enemies with ninja stars rather than attempting to hit them with your sword.
Sometimes it's better to go back to early levels so that you can buy a bunch of upgrades from the in-game shopkeeper to help you in the later stages.
You will get a 10% Awesome-Points bonus for each boss you kill!
Hoptron can hit enemy projectiles back at them with a well-placed sword slash.
The Hop Arena hosts a daily tournament where you face off in a score challenge against 10 other real players. Winning will get you closer to unlocking Hoptron's ultimate ability!
Health carrots get a bit more expensive each time you buy them. Try not to buy them until you really need them!
Hoptron gets a whole lot more badass after spending some Awesome-Points on upgrades. Upgrading HP and Damage is especially useful. Use your AP wisely!
The key to beating the Eggplant is to stay behind him. He can't hurt you when you are behind him!
The game will auto-save every couple minutes, so if it crashes (I swear I tried to fix all the bugs, sorry) you will be able to resume without losing much progress.
When you save and return to the menu you can resume exactly where you left off! Perfect for short subway rides or whatevs.
The Magic Man will only steal upgrades you bought from the in-game shop keeper the very first time you reach a new level.
Hoptron is exactly 4.2 bananas tall. Normal bananas... not evil ones.
The game is a lot easier if you are awesome. Try to be awesome while playing.
You can get more Awesome-Points by going back to earlier levels and playing through them again, gaining big bonuses for beating many levels in a single game!
When you use the Giant's Rage powerup and become huge, you will hit enemies 2x harder and take 2x less damage!
